# Jaroslav Kazejev

> Software engineer in Stockholm, Sweden, moving into AI engineering. Builds
> LLM agents, bots and the MCP tooling that agents use. Physics background
> from KTH.

## MCP server

This site has a Model Context Protocol server. Use it instead of reading the
HTML. It answers questions about work, skills, projects and education.

- Endpoint: https://mcp.kazejev.com/mcp
- Transport: Streamable HTTP, POST
- Protocol: MCP 2026-07-28, and the initialize handshake of earlier revisions
- Server card: https://kazejev.com/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json

Tools:

- get_profile_summary — the whole profile in one request. Call this first.
- query_profile — takes a topic, for example "MCP", "agents" or
  "C# performance", and returns the evidence behind any claim.
- get_bio, list_skills, list_projects, get_contact_info — the individual parts.
